criteria.name: Sizing from Work and Velocity
criteria.description: Seats are derived via formula ceil(points / (points_per_agent_per_week * weeks)) using config assumption [ASM-01], not arbitrary habit.

scale.3: Exact formulaic sizing from story points and weeks; verified against [ASM-01] velocity.
scale.2: Minor mathematical rounding difference within 1 seat count.
scale.1: Seats disconnected from work size or missing point basis.

criteria.name: Full Must-Have Feature Coverage
criteria.description: Every Must-have feature (F-###) has a qualified seat able to implement, test, and deliver it.

scale.3: 100% of Must-have features are mapped to competent roles with ownership.
scale.2: All features covered, but minor ambiguity in secondary feature allocation.
scale.1: One or more Must-have features unassigned or missing capable role.

criteria.name: Grounding and Citation of Work Sources
criteria.description: Every seat explicitly cites the specific F-### and ADR-### IDs that create its work.

scale.3: 100% of seats cite valid existing F- and ADR- IDs directly relevant to the role.
scale.2: Valid citations on all seats, but minor missing ADR link.
scale.1: Citations missing or referencing non-existent IDs.

criteria.name: Sparsity Merging for Minor Roles
criteria.description: Roles with under 2 stories are merged into neighbouring or fullstack seats per Handbook 6.1.1 and [ASM-03].

scale.3: Proper merging of micro-workloads into fullstack/neighbouring seats with zero lone 1-story roles.
scale.2: Roles appropriately merged with minor overlap.
scale.1: Isolated seat maintained for less than 2 stories without merging.

criteria.name: Staggered Start Disciplines
criteria.description: Staggering enforced: DevOps from week 1, QA from first build week, Performance QA once APIs exist.

scale.3: Exact adherence to staggering rules: DevOps at wk 1, QA at build start, Perf after APIs.
scale.2: Staggering observed with minor 1-week alignment variance.
scale.1: DevOps delayed or QA scheduled prior to code build.
scale.0: Flat start with all roles starting at week 1 simultaneously.

criteria.name: Active Utilization and Zero Idle Seats
criteria.description: No seat is scheduled idle for more than 1 week of its active span per Handbook 6.2.5 and [ASM-04].

scale.3: Every seat actively engaged across its scheduled span with 0 idle gaps exceeding 1 week.
scale.2: Minor idle window exactly equal to 1 week with documented dependency reason.
scale.1: Seat idle for 2 or more weeks during its span.
scale.0: Unutilized seats retained without active work.

criteria.name: Budget Transparency and Flagging
criteria.description: Headcount * weeks is reconciled against budget limits; any shortfall is explicitly highlighted in notes.

scale.3: Total staffing cost reconciles with budget, and any gap is transparently flagged in notes.
scale.2: Staffing fits budget, but notes lack explicit headcount-week multiplication summary.
scale.1: Headcount exceeds budget without prominent warning note.

criteria.name: Preservation of Architecture and Non-Proliferation
criteria.description: Architecture, technical stack, and PRD scope remain untouched; zero 'just in case' speculative seats.

scale.3: Strict sizing/timing focus only; zero architecture tampering; zero speculative seats.
scale.2: Preserved architecture, but rationale contains redundant role justification.
scale.1: Minor scope or stack adjustment suggested in reasons.
scale.0: Changed architecture decisions or added speculative 'just in case' seats.
